Shandong INLONG Zhilian Additive Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd. (short name "INLONG Zhilian") was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China. It is a comprehensive high-tech enterprise that combines R&D and manufacturing of industrial-grade additive manufacturing equipment, process development for high-performance material printing, and integrated additive manufacturing services.
The company is building the Qingdao INLONG Additive Manufacturing Industrial Park, with a total investment of RMB 518 million (phase 1 floor area about 20,000 m²). It has established a fully self-developed workflow covering "materials, equipment, processes, and software," and has three R&D centers in Qingdao, Nanjing, and Hong Kong. Its flagship product, the VULCAN 600, uses an exclusive patented far-infrared heating system that addresses common industry issues such as warping, cracking, and insufficient interlayer strength. This makes INLONG the first company in the world to apply far-infrared heating to 3D printing and reach mass production. Its self-developed large-format industrial equipment, the SC12060, uses high-precision closed-loop linear motor drive for contactless "zero-transmission" motion, supports printing with reinforced composites such as carbon fiber and glass fiber, and the printed parts can be used directly as functional end-use components.
The company has been recognized as a National High-Tech Enterprise and a Shandong Province "Specialized, Refined, Differentiated, and Innovative" enterprise. It has fully passed certifications including IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001, and holds more than 100 items of independent intellectual property. Supported by an integrated service system of in-house R&D, technical support, and after-sales teams, it provides full lifecycle maintenance for its equipment. It has deployed 24/7 print service centers in Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Shenzhen, Chongqing, Shijiazhuang and other cities, and has set up pre-sales and after-sales technical centers in Shanghai. Together, these form a nationwide, efficiently coordinated additive manufacturing service network. It has long served high-end manufacturing sectors such as aerospace, automotive design, manufacturing and modification, drones, intelligent robots, and medical devices, and maintains stable partnerships with many industry-leading companies.

山东英龙智联增材技术有限公司（简称“英龙智造”）创建于 2012 年，总部位于中国青岛，是一家集工业级增材制造装备研发制造、高性能材料打印工艺开发、一体化增材制造服务于一体的综合型高新技术企业。
公司拥有总投资 5.18 亿元的青岛英龙增材智造产业园（一期建筑面积约 2 万平方米），已建成“材料—装备—工艺—软件”全流程自主研发体系，并在青岛、南京、香港设立三大研发中心。旗舰产品 VULCAN 600 搭载独家专利远红外加热系统，系统破解翘曲、开裂、层间强度不足等行业痛点，使公司成为全球首家将远红外加热技术应用于 3D 打印并实现规模化量产的企业；自主研发的大尺寸工业级装备 SC12060 采用高精度闭环直线电机驱动，实现无接触“零传动”，支持碳纤维、玻璃纤维等增强复合材料打印，打印件可直接作为功能性终端部件使用。
公司先后获评国家高新技术企业、山东省专精特新企业，全面通过 IATF 16949、ISO 9001、ISO 14001、ISO 45001 等体系认证，累计拥有自主知识产权百余项。依托自主研发、技术支持、售后团队三位一体的服务体系，为设备提供全生命周期维护服务。目前已在北京、上海、南京、深圳、重庆、石家庄等地布局服务7*24小时打印服务中心，在上海建立售前售后技术中心，形成辐射全国、协同高效的增材制造服务矩阵，长期服务航空航天、汽车设计制造与改装、无人机、智能机器人、医疗器械等高端制造领域，并与多家行业龙头企业建立稳定合作。

pr: 데스크톱 산업용 FDM 3D 프린터
桌面工业级FDM3D打印机
X2Pro

Redefining desktop manufacturing: 300×300×260 mm build volume and 35 kg machine body, bringing industrial-grade capability to the desktop.
400℃ quick-change SE hotend (500℃ module optional), 150℃ heated bed, 300 mm/s printing. Handles everything from PLA to PA-CF/GF, PPS, and TPE/TPU, including materials that print at 400℃ and below.
Z-axis optical positioning with 16-point automatic leveling. Full-bed leveling is completed at power-on, with no manual intervention required. The patented motorless hotend switching lets you swap the nozzle in one step, with no tools and no mess.
All-metal reinforced body with a precision drive system, accuracy ±0.03 mm/100 mm. Every layer is finely formed, taking you from prototype straight to usable parts.

重新定义桌面制造：300×300×260mm 成型空间、35kg 机身，把工业级能力放上桌面。
400℃ 秒拆 SE 喷头（可选配 500℃ 模组）、150℃ 高温热床、300mm/s 打印，PLA 至 PA-CF/GF、PPS、TPE/TPU 等 400℃ 以下材料通吃。
Z 轴光学定位 + 16 点平面自动校正，开机即完成全域调平，全程免手动干预；专利免电机切换喷头一键秒拆，免工具、零污染。
全金属加固机身配精密传动系统，精度 ±0.03mm/100mm，每一层精细呈现，从原型直达可用件。

大尺寸高性能纤维复材FDM3D打印
INLONG 全国7*24小时

Printing carbon fiber and glass fiber, making end-use parts. High-performance fiber composites such as PA-CF/GF, PET-CF, PPS-CF, and PEEK balance lightweight design with high strength. Printed parts can be used directly as functional end-use components. From sample validation and small-batch production to end-part replacement, we cover the full needs of industrial customers in one place.
Large size, printed in one piece. Build volume up to 1200×800×1000 mm. Large, complex parts need no tooling or splicing, which significantly shortens lead times and lowers costs.
Proven in application. Humanoid robot housings and structural parts, complete inspection robot housings and brackets, agricultural drone blades and material hoppers, and automotive modification interior/exterior trim and functional parts. Coverage includes lightweight design of complex structures, custom molds, tooling and fixtures, custom large products, integrated manufacturing of complex structures, and part repair and remanufacturing.
7×24 print service centers, local delivery. We have established print service centers in Qingdao, Nanjing, Shenzhen, Beijing, Chongqing, Shijiazhuang and other cities, covering the Bohai Rim, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Chengdu–Chongqing manufacturing belts. From drawing review and material selection to post-processing and inspection, we provide one-stop on-site support.
Low-altitude economy, commercial drones, aerospace, intelligent robots, medical devices, automotive manufacturing and modification. INLONG printing services turn drawings into parts that work.

打的是碳纤玻纤，用的是终端零件。 PA-CF/GF、PET-CF、PPS-CF、PEEK 等高性能纤维复材，兼顾轻量化与高强度，打印件可直接作为功能终端件使用——从样件验证、小批量制造到终端零件替代，一站式满足工业客户的完整需求。
大尺寸，敢一次成型。 最大 1200×800×1000mm 成型空间，大型复杂件省去开模与拼接，显著缩短周期、降低成本。
应用即证明。 人形机器人外壳与结构件、巡检机器人整机外壳与支架、植保无人机桨叶与料仓、汽车改装内外饰与功能件——复杂结构轻量化设计、定制模具、工装夹具、大型产品定制、复杂结构一体化制造、零件修复与再制造，服务场景全覆盖。
7×24 打印服务中心，就近交付。 已在青岛、南京、深圳、北京、重庆、石家庄等地建立 打印服务中心，覆盖环渤海、长三角、珠三角与成渝制造带。从图纸评审、材料选型到后处理检测，一站式现场支持。
低空经济、商用无人机、航空航天、智能机器人、医疗器械、汽车制造与改装——INLONG 打印服务，把图纸变成能用的零件。

대형 항온 챔버 산업용 FDM 3D 프린터
大尺寸恒温腔工业级 FDM 3D 打印机
Vulcan600

Mastering fire, perfecting craft, sustaining strength: built for production manufacturing and high-performance components.
Patented graphene far-infrared constant-temperature chamber reaches 150℃ in 6 minutes. Combined with a 150℃ heated bed, it heats evenly from the inside out and controls crystallization precisely, strengthening interlayer fusion and suppressing warping. The 525℃ hotend prints 20+ materials smoothly, including PEEK, PEKK, and ULTEM.
600×500×500 mm large build volume, accuracy ±0.1 mm/100 mm, high-speed printing at 300–500 mm/s. Active drying at ≤10% RH, INLONG OS remote job scheduling and resume-after-filament-break, for 7×24 hours of continuous production.
600 kg lightweight body, single-phase 220V plug-and-play, backed by 13 independent patents and CE certification.

驭火之智，精铸之艺，永续之力——为量产制造与高性能部件而生。
专利石墨烯远红外恒温腔 6 分钟升温至 150℃，配合 150℃ 热床，由内而外均匀加热、精确控晶，强化层间熔合、抑制翘曲；525℃ 喷头畅打 PEEK、PEKK、ULTEM 等 20+ 种材料。
600×500×500mm 大幅面，精度 ±0.1mm/100mm，300–500mm/s 高速打印；≤10%RH 主动干料，INLONG OS 远程排产与断料续打，7×24 小时连续生产。
600kg 轻量机身，单相 220V 即插即用，13 项自主专利与 CE 认证护航。

米级恒温腔工业级 FDM 3D 打印机
Vulcan1200

1200×800×1000 mm single-piece build. Large tooling and structural parts need no splicing.
Patented far-infrared constant-temperature chamber at 150℃, heated bed at 150℃. Heats evenly and controls crystallization precisely, suppressing warping and cracking. Dual hotends at 525℃; the right hotend switches automatically with raise/lower action. The 0.8 mm nozzle can be swapped to 0.6 or 1.2 mm. Supports 20+ materials, from PA612-CF to PEEK, PEKK, and PAEK.
XYZ three-axis ball-screw gantry with servo drive, mechanical accuracy ±0.01 mm, forming accuracy ±0.10 mm/100 mm. 300–500 mm/s, with 1.2 mm nozzle throughput above 650 g/h. Optical probe auto-leveling plus 12-point assisted leveling.
i7 industrial PC with Inlong3D_OS. Four-spool hopper dries to ≤5% RH, enabling unattended production-line operation.

1200×800×1000mm 一体成型，大型工装与结构件无需拼接。
专利远红外恒温腔 150℃、热床 150℃，均匀加热、精准控晶，抑制翘曲开裂；双喷头 525℃，右喷自动切换升降，0.8mm 喷嘴可选 0.6/1.2mm，PA612-CF 至 PEEK、PEKK、PAEK 共 20+ 种材料。
XYZ 三轴滚珠丝杠滑台配伺服驱动，机械精度 ±0.01mm、成型精度 ±0.10mm/100mm；300–500mm/s，1.2mm 喷嘴效率 >650g/h；光学探针自动校平 + 12 点辅助调平。
i7 工控 + Inlong3D_OS，4 卷料仓除湿至 ≤5%RH，产线级无人值守。

大尺寸工业级 FDM 3D 打印机

1200×600×600 mm single-piece build. Large prototypes and small-batch production are simpler.
Linear motor with a high-precision platform, XY accuracy 5 μm, forming accuracy 0.15 mm/100 mm. 30–180 mm/s, with 0.8 mm nozzle throughput above 120 g/h.
In-house high-speed, high-flow hotend with dual extrusion drive gears and 3-second quick-release. 0.6 mm standard, compatible with 0.4–1.2 mm, up to 400℃. Insulated enclosure with 110℃ flexible magnetic heated bed, stable forming of ABS, ASA, PA, PPS, and CF/GF reinforced materials.
15.6-inch touchscreen, Win10 industrial PC, real-time monitoring. Runs on single-phase 220V/32A, 2500 W, with zero-barrier deployment.

1200×600×600mm 一次成型，大件打样与小批量生产更简单。
直线电机配高精度平台，XY 精度 5μm、成型精度 0.15mm/100mm；30–180mm/s，0.8mm 喷嘴效率 >120g/h。
自研高速高流量喷头，双挤出轮送料、3 秒快拆；0.6mm 标配、兼容 0.4–1.2mm，最高 400℃；保温舱体配 110℃ 柔性磁吸热床，ABS/ASA/PA/PPS 及 CF/GF 增强材料稳定成型。
15.6 英寸触屏、Win10 工控、实时监控；单相 220V/32A、2500W 即可运行，部署零门槛。
